description: §15.10.1 (S459 round 6, F1) — read side: inside lifted markup, text before the nested `${ const label = "S" }` reads the prop (L); the later siblings — text and a quoted attribute — read the local (S). The lifted markup is its own scope: the component markup after the lift still reads the prop (L). Before round 6 every read inside the lift rendered L.
rationale: §15.10.1: "From the point of declaration onward in the same scope, the local binding shadows the prop."
